hypothesis: Parastichy numbers increase with head size in sunflowers.
pass_criterion: Spearman correlation between head diameter (or seed count) and the larger parastichy number is above 0.5 (p<0.01), with larger heads showing 55/89 or 89/144 pairs.
interpretation: Requires a head size measure in the spreadsheet. The page does not list columns, so seed count (the sum of the two parastichy numbers) is the fallback proxy.
